title: Spiral Matrix Order

monster.name: Vortex Titan
monster.title: Guardian of Inward Spirals
monster.defeatQuote: The concentric boundaries wound inwards without missing a tile!

description: Given an `m x n` `matrix`, return all elements of the `matrix` in spiral order.
hints: Maintain top, bottom, left, right bounds and shrink them inward after each direction.
